undervaluation.definition: n. too low a value or price assigned to something
undervaluation.translation:
n. 低估, 轻视
[经] 低估价值

undervalue.definition:
v. assign too low a value to
v. esteem lightly
undervalue.translation:
vt. 低估...之价值, 低估, 看轻
[经] 低估, 降低...价值

undervalued.definition:
v assign too low a value to
v esteem lightly
v lose in value
undervalued.translation:
a. 售价过低的
v. 对（某人或某事物）评价过低, 低估（某人或某事物）( undervalue的过去式和过去分词 )

undervalues.definition:
v assign too low a value to
v esteem lightly
v lose in value
undervalues.translation: v. 对（某人或某事物）评价过低, 低估（某人或某事物）( undervalue的第三人称单数 )

undervaluing.definition:
v assign too low a value to
v esteem lightly
v lose in value
undervaluing.translation: v. 对（某人或某事物）评价过低, 低估（某人或某事物）( undervalue的现在分词 )
